title: Tichuca Rooftop Bar (Bangkok)
description: Drink Beneath an absolutely massive, glowing LED jellyfish structure spanning three floors. This jungle-themed rooftop offers the most striking visual.
content:
> **Executive Summary:**
>
> * Tichuca Rooftop Bar, located on the 46th floor of the T-One building in Bangkok, features a massive, glowing LED jellyfish structure spanning three floors and a jungle-themed aesthetic. This venue targets the premium youth and expat market with its vibrant, Instagrammable, tiki-jungle concept.
> * The bar offers a two-hour experience with low physical demand, characterized by upbeat house music, 360-degree city views, and a menu of rum-heavy tiki cocktails. It is best paired as a warm-up before visiting Sukhumvit clubs.
> * Asia Golf Specialists (AGS) provides priority reservations, skip-the-line access, and luxury private SUV transfers for Tichuca, which is open year-round and requires advance booking. A smart casual dress code is universally respected.
>
> *Related: Explore our [Premium Southeast Asia Tours](/tours/) luxury itinerary.*

## The AGS Executive Summary
Drink Beneath an absolutely massive, glowing LED jellyfish structure spanning three floors. This jungle-themed rooftop offers the most striking visual in modern Bangkok nightlife.

## The Operator & Origin Story
Moving away from the ultra-formal, stiff skybars of the past, Tichuca introduced a fun, highly Instagrammable, tiki-jungle concept to the 46th floor of the T-One building, immediately capturing the premium youth and expat market.

## The Itinerary & Deep Dive
Take the express lift to the top open-air floor. The visual center is immediately obvious: an enormous tree-like structure draped in thousands of swaying, color-changing LED ropes that react to the wind. 

The vibe is significantly more energetic and youthful than traditional sky bars. Order from a menu of complex, rum-heavy tiki cocktails and enjoy the upbeat house tracks and 360-degree city views.

## Experience Data
| Metric | Details |
|---|---|
| **Vibe / Atmosphere** | Vibrant, Visual, Trend-setting |
| **Duration** | 2 Hours |
| **Physical Demand** | Low |
| **Best Paired With** | Warm-up drinks before hitting Sukhumvit clubs. |

## Sunset & Early-Evening Tiki Cocktails Beneath Thonglor’s 46th-Floor LED Tree
Perched on the 46th to 50th floors of the T-One Building at the entrance of Sukhumvit Soi 40 (Thonglor)—just 15 minutes from [Sindhorn Kempinski Hotel Bangkok](/accommodations/thailand/sindhorn-kempinski/)—**Tichuca Rooftop Bar** has become the most photographed skyline venue in Bangkok. For golf groups returning from a morning round at [Ballyshear Golf Links (Ban Rakat Club)](/courses/thailand/ballyshear/), [Thai Country Club](/courses/thailand/thai-country-club/), [Alpine Golf Club](/courses/thailand/alpine-golf-club/), or [Laem Chabang International Country Club](/courses/thailand/laem-chabang/), Tichuca works best as a high-energy 5:30 PM to 7:30 PM sunset warm-up before a celebratory dinner at [Sorn](/destinations/thailand/thailand-culinary-sorn-southern-fine-dining/) or a late-night booth at [Sing Sing Theater](/destinations/thailand/thailand-nightlife-sing-sing-theater-bangkok/).

## How to Beat the Elevator Queue & Navigate Tichuca’s Multi-Tier Deck
* **Arrive Between 5:15 PM and 5:45 PM:** Because Tichuca’s glowing biomorphic LED "jellyfish tree" attracts massive walk-in queues after 8:00 PM, arriving right after sunset prep at 5:30 PM lets your group ascend the express elevator with minimal wait, watch the LED tentacles ignite against the twilight sky over the Chao Phraya River bend, and claim a table on the 46th-floor main terrace or climb the spiral stairs to the 50th-floor breeze deck.
* **Smart-Casual Footwear & ID Protocol:** Bring a physical passport or clear photo ID (strictly checked at the ground-floor reception desk for all guests) and wear closed-toe shoes and smart-casual attire.

## Combining Tichuca With Sukhumvit Fine Dining & Championship Golf
After a morning tee time at [Thai Country Club](/courses/thailand/thai-country-club/), [Ballyshear Golf Links](/courses/thailand/ballyshear/), or [Cascata Golf Club](/courses/thailand/cascata/) and an afternoon pool session at [Sindhorn Kempinski Hotel Bangkok](/accommodations/thailand/sindhorn-kempinski/) or [Riva Surya Bangkok](/accommodations/thailand/riva-surya-bangkok/), starting your evening at Tichuca at 5:30 PM puts your group right in the heart of Sukhumvit—less than 10 minutes from two-Michelin-starred [Sorn](/destinations/thailand/thailand-culinary-sorn-southern-fine-dining/) and late-night bottle service at [Sing Sing Theater](/destinations/thailand/thailand-nightlife-sing-sing-theater-bangkok/).

faqs.q: What is the best time for a golf group to arrive at Tichuca Rooftop Bar in Bangkok?
faqs.a: Arriving between 5:15 PM and 5:45 PM after your morning golf round lets you bypass the late-night elevator queue, watch the giant LED jellyfish structure light up at dusk, and enjoy 360-degree views before a 7:30 PM dinner in Thonglor or Phrom Phong.

faqs.q: Do golfers need to bring identification and wear closed-toe shoes to Tichuca?
faqs.a: Yes. Tichuca's ground-floor reception requires a passport or government ID check for every guest (20+ years old) and enforces a smart-casual dress code with closed-toe shoes required for men.

faqs.q: Where is Tichuca located in relation to Bangkok's golf courses and Sukhumvit nightlife?
faqs.a: Tichuca sits on the 46th floor of the T-One Building at Sukhumvit Soi 40 (Thonglor)—30 minutes west of Ballyshear Golf Links and Thai Country Club, and 5 minutes from Sing Sing Theater.
